query:
UPDATE users
            SET auth_method = $1,
                email = $2,
                password_hash = $3,
                role = $4,
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE id = $5
              AND auth_method = 'NameWithCookie'
            RETURNING
                id,
                name as "name: Name",
                email as "email?: Email",
                auth_method as "auth_method: AuthMethod",
                password_hash,
                role as "role?: UserRole",
                created_at,
                updated_at
